verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Lemon Squeezy. The closest items are metrics monitoring, subscriber-behaviour analytics and auto-updating 'intelligent segments', which are standard analytics and rule-based segmentation, not AI-generated insights. The axis applies to a commerce/billing SaaS, so the absence of evidence means 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
